articles.title: Slovenka s deťmi v Írsku: Jasle nás stáli koľko som zarábala, za lekára dáte 200 eur a na pohotovosti platíte 100. No život tu má aj druhú stránku (rozhovor)
articles.en: Slovak woman with children in Ireland: Nursery cost us what I used to earn, a doctor costs 200 euros and at emergency you pay 100. But life here also has another side (interview)
